name: Disk I/O (Read/Write, MB)
programText:
(data('kafka_server_kafkaserver_value', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-broker') and filter('name', 'linux-disk-read-bytes') and filter('service.instance.id', 'kafka-0')) / 1024/1024).publish(label='Read')
(data('kafka_server_kafkaserver_value', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-broker') and filter('name', 'linux-disk-write-bytes') and filter('service.instance.id', 'kafka-0')) / 1024/1024).publish(label='Write')
